finding.title: Archive the stale 993-line root coding-standards.md superseded by docs/coding-standards.md

evidence.quote:
// REQUIRED - Always UTC
final now = DateTime.now().toUtc();

finding.why: Two documents claim to be the coding-standards authority. The root one (993 lines, older) actively contradicts the canonical docs/coding-standards.md — e.g. it REQUIRES `DateTime.now().toUtc()` while audit check 6 bans `DateTime.now()` outside core/time entirely. An agent that greps for coding-standards can land on the wrong file and follow dead rules; a doc that lies is worse than no doc.
finding.recommendation: Move root coding-standards.md to docs/_archive/ (or delete it) and leave nothing at the root but a pointer; sweep other root-level docs for the same staleness.
acceptance_criteria: root coding-standards.md gone or replaced by a one-line pointer to docs/coding-standards.md
doc-lint/audit grep asserting only one file named coding-standards.md exists outside _archive

finding.title: Remove committed build artifacts (build/) and the accidental 'clear' file from git

evidence.quote: tracked EMPTY database file (+ seed.db.xz binary)
Unicode text with terminal escape sequences — accidentally committed command output

finding.why: Build outputs and a stray terminal-dump are version-controlled at the repo root. They confuse agents scanning the manifest ('is build/seed.db the canonical seed?'), bloat the repo (binary .xz), and signal that .gitignore doesn't cover the root build/ directory.
finding.recommendation: git rm build/ and clear; add root build/ (and *.log at root) to .gitignore; verify tool scripts regenerate seed artifacts under an ignored path.
acceptance_criteria: git ls-files shows no build/ entries and no 'clear' file

finding.title: Archive legacy _bmad-output/ reports per the CLAUDE.md output-path policy

evidence.quote: 30 legacy refactor-wave outputs still live in _bmad-output/

finding.why: Root CLAUDE.md states BMAD outputs now write into docs/, not _bmad-output/. The 30 files there are point-in-time wave logs that predate the policy; leaving them at a top-level path agents scan invites them to be read as current guidance.
finding.recommendation: Move _bmad-output/** into docs/_archive/ (they are historical logs) and delete the directory.
acceptance_criteria: _bmad-output/ no longer exists in git; files live under docs/_archive/ with a README pointer

finding.title: De-duplicate 7 public type names defined in two files each (AG-4)

evidence.quote: CurriculumSummary, PaceCalculator, PaceIndicator, PaceStatus, PinFlowMode, PinFlowStep, StudyDayPattern each defined in 2 lib/ files (script scan; pairs in appendix)

finding.why: Agents locate code by grep; a duplicated public name sends them to the wrong definition and breeds divergent parallel copies — this repo's documented accretion failure. PaceCalculator/PaceStatus duplicated across features is exactly how two pace algorithms drift apart silently.
finding.recommendation: For each pair: keep one canonical definition (core/ or the owning feature), rename or delete the other, and land the AG-4 duplicate-symbol audit script so the count ratchets to zero.
acceptance_criteria: AG-4 audit script lands in make audit and reports zero duplicate public top-level type names
each of the 7 names resolves to exactly one lib/ definition

finding.title: Add Linear IDs to the 8 untracked TODO/FIXME comments (AG-6)

evidence.quote: 8 TODO/FIXME comments without a DNI-#### id (grep scan; list in appendix)

finding.why: Untracked TODOs are parked half-finished work that no ticket owns; they persist as cross-wave noise until someone re-discovers them the hard way.
finding.recommendation: File or link a DNI ticket for each of the 8 and generalize audit check 10 into the AG-6 grep (TODO/FIXME without DNI- fails).
acceptance_criteria: audit grep for untracked TODO/FIXME returns zero
